{**A hybrid of Simulated Annealing (SA) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), which combines their exploration-exploitation trade-off capabilities to efficiently search for the global minimum of the 5-dimensional Rosenbrock function.**}

def algorithm(func, dim, lb, ub, budget, rng):
    def evaluate(x):
        return func(x)

    pop_size = int(np.sqrt(budget))
    population = np.random.uniform(lb, ub, (pop_size, dim))

    sa_best = population[0]
    psobest = population[0]

    for i in range(budget - 1):
        # Simulated Annealing
        t = 1.0 / (i + 1)
        new_population = np.copy(population)
        for j in range(pop_size):
            x = new_population[j]
            delta = rng.uniform(-10, 10, dim) * 0.01
            y = x + delta
            new_y = np.clip(y, lb, ub)

            if evaluate(new_y) < evaluate(x):
                population[j] = new_y

        # Particle Swarm Optimization
        for j in range(pop_size):
            v = rng.uniform(-10, 10, dim) * 0.01
            y = population[j] + v
            new_y = np.clip(y, lb, ub)

            if evaluate(new_y) < evaluate(psobest):
                psobest = new_y

        # Update SA best position
        sa_best = np.copy(psobest)

    return sa_best
